title: Reading vowel teams: ai, ee and oa

explain.say: Imagine two vowels on a team, working together. Vowels are the letters a, e, i, o and u. Look at rain on the board. The a and the i team up to make one sound.

draw.text: Reading vowel teams: ai, ee and oa

explain.say: Look at the middle part glowing: a and i. Together they say the name of the letter a, like in rain and train. Two letters, one sound. Can you say rain?
Here is a team of two e letters. Together they say the name of the letter e, like in see and tree. Look at feet. Tap three sounds and blend. Can you read it?
Now o and a team up. They say the name of the letter o, like in boat and goat. Look at the boat on the board. Three taps, three sounds. Great reading!
Look at the board: each team has its own family of words. Well done, team player! Challenge: how many ee words can you think of before the count of ten?

faq.a: A vowel team is two letters that work together to make one vowel sound, like ai in rain, ee in feet and oa in boat.
ai usually says the name of the letter a, like in rain, tail and paint.
ee says the name of the letter e, like in see, tree and feet.
oa says the name of the letter o, like in boat, coat and road.

faq.q: How can I remember the vowel teams?
faq.a: Draw a little loop around the two letters, so your eyes see them as one. Make a picture card for each team: a rain cloud for ai, a tree for ee and a boat for oa.
asks: How do I remember ai, ee and oa?

facts: Rain, feet and boat each have four letters but only three sounds.
The vowel teams ai, ee and oa usually make the sound of a vowel letter name.

quiz.say: What sound does ee make in tree?
quiz.show: The sound of ee in tree?

options.show: The name of the letter e
options.say: The name of the letter e

quiz.why: ee says the name of the letter e, like in see and tree.

wrong.1: The e in egg is the short sound. Two e letters together say the name of e.
wrong.2: Both letters work together to make one clear sound.

quiz.say: Which word has the oa team?
quiz.why: Coat has o and a together, saying the name of the letter o.

wrong.1: Cat has just one vowel, a.
